result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.select_nodes_in_neighborhood()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Select all nodes within K hops of specified seed nodes. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L5836-L5930){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.select_nodes_in_neighborhood(nodes, k=1, mode="out") ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Uses breadth-first search to find neighbors at distance up to k from the seed nodes. Does not include the seed nodes themselves in the selection. Useful for extracting local neighborhoods. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [nodes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[Union[int, str]] | int | str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Seed node(s) to start from. Can be a single node ID (int), a single label (str), or a list of node IDs/labels. [k]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[1]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Maximum number of hops/distance to traverse. [mode]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["out"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Direction to traverse: `"out"`, `"in"`, or `"all"`. For undirected graphs, always uses the `"all"` mode. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Select 1-hop neighborhood using node ID: ::: {#85731483 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph().add_star_graph(n=5) # Get the center node ID (first node created) all_node_ids = list(graph.get_node_ids(limit=None)) center_id = all_node_ids[0] graph.select_nodes_in_neighborhood(nodes=center_id, k=1, mode="all") # Selects all neighbors of center (not center itself) count = graph.count_selected_nodes() # Returns expected: neighbors of center count ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 2 ``` ::: ::: Select 2-hop neighborhood using label: ::: {#8064cf2d .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") .add_edge("C", "D") ) graph.select_nodes_in_neighborhood(nodes="A", k=2, mode="out") # Selects B and C (reachable within 2 hops from A) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` Number of nodes : 4 Number of edges : 3 Directed : True Density : 0.25 Average degree (min, max) : 1.50 (1, 2) Strongly connected : False Weakly connected : True Number of strongly connected components : 4 Number of weakly connected components : 1 ``` ::: ::: Select neighborhood from multiple seed nodes: ::: {#6b99a377 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_node(label="E") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("A", "C") .add_edge("B", "D") .add_edge("C", "E") ) # Select using multiple seed nodes graph.select_nodes_in_neighborhood(nodes=["A", "B"], k=1, mode="all") # Selects neighbors of both A and B (not A and B themselves) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` Number of nodes : 5 Number of edges : 4 Directed : False Density : 0.40 Average degree (min, max) : 1.60 (1, 2) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True ``` ::: :::
